messages.content: Please check the Monday rental pickup carefully. The reservation time looks uncomfortably close to the counter closing.

Your United flight is scheduled into PDX at 12:33 p.m. The rental is set for 1:40 p.m., and that counter closes at 2:00 p.m. Allowing 10-15 minutes to deplane and roughly 20 minutes to reach the rental area leaves only 12-22 minutes; checked-bag or gate delays could erase that margin.
What does the agency do if the flight is late? Also confirm whether my flight is actually attached to the reservation.

The flight-number field on PDX3C84 is blank. The agency says it will hold an airport reservation until 2:30 p.m. when the arriving flight number is recorded before arrival. Without it, the vehicle can be released at 2:00 p.m. If the flight arrives after 2:30, pickup moves to the next morning because there is no after-hours key procedure.
That still leaves some exposure. What is the exact total for the later-closing agency in the same terminal?

The alternate counter is open until 11:30 p.m. Its comparable compact is $421.60 for Monday through Friday, payable at pickup, with taxes and airport fees included. That is $67.60 more than the existing $354.00 reservation. No fuel plan, insurance, or other optional products are included.
Is the United flight currently on time, and can the existing agency confirm in writing that adding it activates the 2:30 hold?

United still shows the flight on schedule for a 12:33 p.m. arrival. The agency has confirmed by email that the 2:30 p.m. hold applies once the inbound flight is entered, and it will note both the carrier and flight number on the confirmation.
Keep the lower rate. Add the United flight, move the stated pickup time to 1:25, and send me the revised confirmation. If the flight develops a substantial delay before departure, I can switch then.

Rental PDX3C84 is revised to a 1:25 p.m. pickup. The United inbound flight is now shown on the reservation, and the written confirmation states that the vehicle will be held until 2:30 p.m. for a delayed arrival. The total remains $354.00 with no optional products. The alternate $421.60 rental has not been booked. Your Hillsboro trip total remains $1,858.44.
